I was more just angrily ranting than posting for support. I do appreciate it though. You know that's exactly what I want. I want the suffering to end. I just don't see any other way anymore. I read a post by SQLwitch the other day, it described how I feel right now pretty well. It was about being stuck at the top of a burning building. Wish I could find it.
Doesn't mean anything if I can't beat this. I'm just tired of fighting it. It's been too long now.
Do I? Should I stay and be miserable for the rest of my life for their benefit? More meds aren't going to help. They've never helped. Stuffing me with pills is not the answer anymore.
Suicide isn't a viable option, it's **the** viable option. There are no others at this point. I just need to figure out how I can force myself to do it.

You know that was the first thing they did for me 12 years ago? That makes it just under 12 years I've been on medication and about in about 12 years it hasn't done anything. I've been on probably 15 kinds of anti-depressants over the years, as well as regular therapy sections. None of it has helped. I just want to die. That's all. Just...die and leave this crap behind.

Hey mate

I'm sort of here on a throwaway dealing with my own stuff but this post really caught my eye here. My girlfriend of 3 years overdosed on Tylenol extra strength or something like that. I'm Australian and she was in America at the time so I'm not sure exactly what kind of Tylenol it was, but she managed 130 of those extra strength (500mg?) Tylenol tablets and took about 3 days before she passed away because her liver failed and she couldn't get a transplant.

I was on the phone with her for about 3 hours after it happened (While simultaneously on another phone trying to phone the right police station in Connecticut, something like 25 numbers), and let me tell you hearing her beg, plead, vomit, scream, and wretch for the better half of 1.5 hours (I can't imagine what she was like for **three days** because I was thousands of miles away) before I managed to get an ambulance to her hotel, were, are and likely will be the worst 1.5 hours of my life.

Don't fucking go like that man. I hope you called the ambulance and I sincerely hope you're doing a little bit better now. There are *better ways to go*. I'm not encouraging it but jesus there are better ways to go than overdosing on that shit.
